sources.material: The previously reviewed current Material Web exports contain no Chart implementation; existing theme/motion decisions remain the comparison constraints.

implementation: Canonical immutable row/series inputs and typed SVG renderer lifetime
Grouped bars, explicit area baselines, missing/nonfinite gaps and true zero
Number, category and UTC Date axes; exact-value disclosure through Collapsible/Table
Opt-in activation requests; default pointer and keyboard inspection
Safe text formatting and authored supplementary tooltip content without reparenting author nodes
Sparkline reuses the engine with no axes, focus or tooltip and separate direction/sentiment
Passive Legend with native hidden semantics and independent composed controls
corrections: UTC ISO data values preserve time-of-day
Default exact-value number formatting preserves small finite values
Explicit public DomChartDefinition return type makes generated declarations portable
Chart palette 2/3 use existing amber-900/blue-900 tokens after measured contrast failures
One orphan Table hue rule discovered during retirement is removed
